scripts.build: tsc && shx cp setup-claude-server.js uninstall-claude-server.js track-installation.js dist/ && shx chmod +x dist/*.js && shx mkdir -p dist/data && shx cp src/data/onboarding-prompts.json dist/data/ && shx mkdir -p dist/remote-device/scripts && shx cp src/remote-device/scripts/blocking-offline-update.js dist/remote-device/scripts/ && node scripts/build-ui-runtime.cjs
scripts.setup: npm install --include=dev && npm run build && node setup-claude-server.js
scripts.setup:debug: npm install && npm run build && node setup-claude-server.js --debug
scripts.remove: npm install && npm run build && node uninstall-claude-server.js
scripts.build:coverage: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.coverage.json && node test/map-copied-scripts.js
scripts.device:start:local: npm run build && DC_ENV=development MCP_SERVER_URL=http://mcp.localhost:3007 npm run device:start:dev
